item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: Meera notes that Diwali, which follows a luni-solar calendar, fell on a different Gregorian date this year compared to last year, while the solar harvest festival Makar Sankranti fell on almost the same date both years. Why does Makar Sankranti stay on nearly the same Gregorian date?

options.A: It is decided by the full Moon each year
options.B: It follows the solar cycle, which matches the Gregorian calendar closely
options.C: An extra month is added to the calendar every few years
options.D: All festivals fall on fixed Gregorian dates every year
